project: Ralph Effect Migration - Phase 2: Service Interfaces

features.description: ConfigService interface is defined with Context.Tag for type-safe dependency injection
steps: Verify interface defines oauthToken, gitRoot, githubToken, featuresPath fields
Verify all config fields from spec are present
features.verification: test -f src/services/Config.ts && grep -q 'Context.Tag' src/services/Config.ts && grep -q 'ConfigService' src/services/Config.ts && grep -q 'oauthToken' src/services/Config.ts

features.description: DockerService interface defines container lifecycle methods (create, start, remove, inspect)
steps: Verify create, start, remove, inspect methods are defined
Check return types use Effect.Effect with proper error channels
features.verification: test -f src/services/Docker.ts && grep -q 'Context.Tag' src/services/Docker.ts && grep -q 'readonly create' src/services/Docker.ts && grep -q 'readonly inspect' src/services/Docker.ts

features.description: DockerService interface defines execution methods (exec, execStream) with streaming support
steps: Verify exec method returns Effect.Effect<string, DockerError>
Verify execStream method returns stdout/stderr streams
features.verification: grep -q 'readonly exec' src/services/Docker.ts && grep -q 'readonly execStream' src/services/Docker.ts && grep -q 'Stream.Stream' src/services/Docker.ts

features.description: DockerService interface defines file operations (readFile, writeFile, copyToContainer, listByPrefix)
steps: Verify readFile, writeFile methods are defined
Verify copyToContainer and listByPrefix methods exist
Check all methods have proper error typing
features.verification: grep -q 'readonly readFile' src/services/Docker.ts && grep -q 'readonly writeFile' src/services/Docker.ts && grep -q 'readonly listByPrefix' src/services/Docker.ts

features.description: ClaudeService interface defines run and runWithEvents methods for CLI invocation
steps: Verify run method returns Effect.Effect<void, ClaudeError | TimeoutError>
features.verification: test -f src/services/Claude.ts && grep -q 'Context.Tag' src/services/Claude.ts && grep -q 'readonly run' src/services/Claude.ts && grep -q 'readonly runWithEvents' src/services/Claude.ts

features.description: GitService interface defines git operations (checkout, fetch, push, hasUnpushedCommits, createBranch, configureUser)
steps: Verify all six git operation methods are defined
Check methods return Effect.Effect with GitError channel
features.verification: test -f src/services/Git.ts && grep -q 'Context.Tag' src/services/Git.ts && grep -q 'readonly checkout' src/services/Git.ts && grep -q 'readonly push' src/services/Git.ts && grep -q 'readonly hasUnpushedCommits' src/services/Git.ts

features.description: DashboardService interface defines state management methods (getState, updateState, setPaused, etc.)
steps: Verify convenience setters (setPaused, setRunning, setStopping, setIteration, setFeatures)
features.verification: test -f src/services/Dashboard.ts && grep -q 'Context.Tag' src/services/Dashboard.ts && grep -q 'readonly getState' src/services/Dashboard.ts && grep -q 'readonly updateState' src/services/Dashboard.ts

features.description: DashboardService interface defines broadcasting methods (broadcast, sendOutput) and lifecycle (start, stop)
steps: Verify broadcast and sendOutput methods exist
Verify start and stop lifecycle methods exist
features.verification: grep -q 'readonly broadcast' src/services/Dashboard.ts && grep -q 'readonly sendOutput' src/services/Dashboard.ts && grep -q 'readonly start' src/services/Dashboard.ts

features.description: Services index file exports all service interfaces for convenient imports
steps: Verify it re-exports ConfigService, DockerService, ClaudeService, GitService, DashboardService
features.verification: test -f src/services/index.ts && grep -q 'ConfigService' src/services/index.ts && grep -q 'DockerService' src/services/index.ts
